summary: AIR Global PLC filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated November 5, 2026 announcing submission of a Premarket Tobacco Product Application (PMTA) to the U.S. FDA for Crown Switch, its rechargeable pod vape platform built on Greentank's Quantum Vape chip-based aerosolization technology. No transaction, price, stake change or board recommendation is involved. Prior context: a July 2026 $20 million preferred equity investment in Greentank at roughly $170 million pre-money, plus a warrant for up to an additional 20% over 24 months. This is a routine regulatory/product milestone disclosure, not a special situation; watch FDA acceptance and filing decisions rather than any deal terms.
